description: Aider-polyglot style (TypeScript): implement a text buffer with undo/redo from a stub and an instructions file - cursor restored on undo and redo, grouped edits as one step (nestable, empty groups leave no history), redo cleared by any recorded edit but not by no-op or rejected ones. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
